name: [UPD] Junk Mechanics
desc:
WEEKLY UPDATES

Buy junk cars. Fix them up. Flip them for profit.

🚗 Buy a car
🔧 Repair it
💰 Sell it
🏆 Collect them all

Explore the junkyard for damaged vehicles, repair what’s broken, repaint them, and sell them for cash. Use your earnings to find rarer cars, unlock new vehicles in your collection, and work your way up to the best flips in the yard.

💻 Supports Desktop, Mobile and Console players
